7. **P2 — The ngrok task can announce an unrelated tunnel.**  
   [jido.connect.ngrok.ex:147](/Users/mhostetler/Source/Jido/proj_jido_integration/jido_connect/apps/jido_connect/lib/mix/tasks/jido.connect.ngrok.ex:147) accepts the first HTTPS tunnel from the API. Its fallback can run before the new process logs its own URL. A local test with `--port 4001` announced the tunnel for port 3000; the correct process URL arrived later. [Dev.Ngrok:20](/Users/mhostetler/Source/Jido/proj_jido_integration/jido_connect/apps/jido_connect/lib/jido_connect/dev/ngrok.ex:20) makes the same selection, which affects manifest and demo callers.  
   **Correction:** Select the requested local target, and reject ambiguous results. The fixed `4040` address alone is a configuration limit; the confirmed defect is accepting an unrelated tunnel.

Acceptance: Reproduce the reported case against current source, apply the smallest correction described above, and add focused verification of both the failing case and supported behavior. For documentation/design work, update the public contract and verify its examples/callers. Preserve tenant, scope, lease, and host ownership boundaries. Use fresh matching v3 dependencies for final verification; saved local v2 build artifacts do not establish v3 conformance.

Do not modify jido_mcp or publish packages. Full source review and its coverage/verification limits are preserved in the parent epic comments.
title: The ngrok task can announce an unrelated tunnel
